page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; a running head at the top; a marginal note at the upper left, beside the first lines (a hyphenated fragment "ris Pontifi-" and "cii."); the digitiser's watermark at bottom right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: subnectenda sunt. Ea varia fuit, crevit &
decrevit. Cum imperium & Majestas Ponti-
ficum Romanorum se per totum Occiden-
tem magis magisque diffunderet, etiam su-
per Imperatores se extolleret, juris quoque
Canonici auctoritas eodem impetu se diffu-
dit & crevit, ita ut Blasphemo errore detor-
ta Augustini & truncata sententia ex lib. 2.
de Doctr. Christ. Gratianus Can. in canonicis,
dist. 19. Decretales inter canonicas
Scripturas retulerit. & qui canones violat, qui instin-
ctu Spiritus sancti dicuntur dati esse, dica-
tur Spiritum S. blasphemare, c. Violatores.
25. q. 1. Imperatores Romano-Germanici
non semper ista incrementa aut Mysterium
quod in conscribendis, edendis & vulgan-
dis Decretalibus & obtrusione juris Ponti-
ficii, latebat, observare potuerunt; aut si vi-
derent, pacis studiosi, tolerarunt; aut po-
tius, quia non poterant impedire, conniv«
runt. Hinc factum, ut omnes Occidentis
populi, Jus canonicum receperint, eoque
in decidendis causis usi fuerint. De Italia,
in qua Auctor ejus juris longe lateque do-
minabatur, non est, quod auctoritates pro-
ducamus. Galli, deficientibus legibus &
consuetudinibus propriis ex jure Canonico
causas in suis Curiis decidi patiuntur, teste Eguinar. Baron. ad l. vonunquam. 11. ff. de justit.

page.notes: Marginal note at upper left: "ris Pontifi-" / "cii." (catchword-like running side note, partly cut). Text of the first line begins "subnectenda sunt." with the preceding word "Pontifi-" hyphenated at the line start in the margin. The "connive-runt" line break is reproduced as printed. The phrase "ad l. vonunquam" is printed with heavy type and is uncertain ([?] applies to "vonunquam": it reads like "nonnunquam"). Final line "justit." is set at right, lower, with "de" above it. Scan damage and stray marks are omitted.
